tools.name: get_system_docs
tools.title: Get system reference
tools.description: Returns the GTeam Infinite system reference: how players, teams, runs, dominations, packs, gems, evolutions and the social feed connect. Read this before creating or editing content.

tools.name: get_diagnostics
tools.title: Get content diagnostics
tools.description: Reports incomplete or broken content: unrated players, teams with fewer than 3 cards, Runs with no opponent roster, Domination games with no roster, packs with no pool or no odds or odds that do not total 100, locker codes with malformed reward payloads, and storylines whose linked entities no longer exist. Call this first when asked to fill gaps.

tools.name: get_references
tools.title: Get reference names
tools.description: Returns the exact names/handles the write tools accept: gem tiers, teams, packs, collections and sub-collections, badges, signature traits, media (location) accounts, storylines, challenges, runs, domination roads, and rule_config keys, plus the full player card name list. Call this before writing so every reference resolves.

tools.name: list_rows
tools.title: List rows
tools.description: Read rows from any GTeam Infinite content table: players, teams and rosters, runs / run rosters / rank rewards, domination games and rosters, challenges, packs with their pools and odds, locker codes, gem tiers and gem market, gem tasks, dynamic duos, collections and sub-collections, badges and signature traits plus their card assignments, evo paths, storylines and storyline entities, social creators and posts, media (location) accounts and post templates, and rule_config. Per-user and economy tables are not exposed.

search.description: Case-insensitive match against the table's name/title/code column.

tools.name: create_players
tools.title: Create players
tools.description: Admin only. Create player cards. Gem tier and team are resolved by name, so you can say `gem_tier: "Diamond"` instead of an id. Ratings accept decimals.

name.description: Card name (must be unique-ish; existing names are reported back).

gem_tier.description: Gem tier name, e.g. Emerald / Diamond.

team.description: Team name to attach the card to.

tools.name: upsert_player
tools.title: Create or update a player card
tools.description: Admin only. Create or update one player card atomically, matched on `name`. Gem tier, team, collection, sub-collection, badges and signature traits are resolved by exact name; an unknown or ambiguous reference fails with zero writes. Sending `badges` or `traits` REPLACES all of that card's assignments. Always call with mode='preview' first.

mode.description: `preview` validates and returns the exact plan without writing. `commit` applies it.

name.description: Existing card name to edit, or the name of the new card.

badges.description: DESTRUCTIVE: replaces every badge assignment on this card.

traits.description: DESTRUCTIVE: replaces every signature-trait assignment on this card.

tools.name: upsert_team
tools.title: Create or update a team
tools.description: Admin only. Create or update a team by name and optionally REPLACE its ordered roster with the given player card names. Player names must already exist (create them with create_players first). Always call with mode='preview' first.

mode.description: `preview` validates and returns the exact plan without writing. `commit` applies it.

category.description: Team category, e.g. domination / run / challenge.

unlock_cost.description: Coin cost to unlock the team.

roster.description: DESTRUCTIVE: replaces the whole team roster with these player card names, in slot order. Omit to leave the roster untouched.

tools.name: upsert_run
tools.title: Create or update a Run
tools.description: Admin only. Create or update a 3v3 Run: target score, milestone ladder, the Run's opponent roster, and optionally the global rank-reward ladder. Roster and rank rewards are full replacements. Always call with mode='preview' first.

mode.description: `preview` validates and returns the exact plan without writing. `commit` applies it.

team.description: Optional team name to link the Run to.

milestones.description: Milestone ladder as stored in runs.milestones (e.g. { wins_required, coin_reward, gem_reward, pack_reward }). Replaces the whole array.

roster.description: DESTRUCTIVE: replaces the Run's opponent roster with these player card names. Run stats are copied from each card's run_* values (falling back to base stats).

rank_rewards.description: DESTRUCTIVE and GLOBAL: run_rank_rewards is one ladder shared by every Run. Sending this replaces the entire ladder.

tools.name: upsert_domination_game
tools.title: Create or update a Domination game
tools.description: Admin only. Create or update a Domination game, matched on road_name + opponent_name: game order, difficulty stars, coin/pack rewards, and optionally its ordered roster (full replacement). Always call with mode='preview' first.

mode.description: `preview` validates and returns the exact plan without writing. `commit` applies it.

road_name.description: Road / path the game belongs to.

opponent_name.description: Opponent name (match key together with road_name).

game_order.description: Position of the game on the road.

pack_reward.description: Pack reward identifier, or null to clear it.

roster.description: DESTRUCTIVE: replaces the opponent roster with these player card names, in slot order.

tools.name: upsert_pack
tools.title: Create or update a pack
tools.description: Admin only. Create or update a pack: cost, ten-box cost, pack type, its player pool (one slot per listed card) and its odds table. Odds are validated the way the pack-opening flow reads them: percentages must total 100, every entry must be above 0, and each result_slot must be `player_choice` or an existing pool slot number. Pool and odds are full replacements. Always call with mode='preview' first.

mode.description: `preview` validates and returns the exact plan without writing. `commit` applies it.

pack_type.description: Pack type, e.g. standard / premium / promo.

cost.description: Coin cost for a single open.

ten_box_cost.description: Coin cost for a ten-box, or null.

players.description: DESTRUCTIVE: replaces the pack pool. Player card names; the first name becomes slot 1, the second slot 2, and so on.

result_slot.description: Pool slot number as a string, or `player_choice`.

percentage.description: Chance for this slot; all entries must sum to 100.

description.description: Label shown in the odds table.

odds.description: DESTRUCTIVE: replaces the pack's odds rows.

tools.name: upsert_locker_code
tools.title: Create or update a locker code
tools.description: Admin only. Create or update a locker code (matched on the code, case-insensitive): reward payload, redemption limit and expiry. Reward payloads are validated and normalised to the shape the redeem flow expects — pass `pack_name` or `card_name` and they are resolved to ids. Always call with mode='preview' first.

mode.description: `preview` validates and returns the exact plan without writing. `commit` applies it.

pack_name.description: For a pack reward; resolved to pack_id.

card_name.description: For a card reward; resolved to player_card_id.

max_redemptions.description: Redemption cap, or null for unlimited.

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp, or null for no expiry.

tools.name: upsert_challenge
tools.title: Create or update a challenge
tools.description: Admin only. Create or update a challenge by name: opponent team, win condition and series setup, stat limits, lineup restrictions, timing, prerequisite, and coin / gem / pack / card rewards. Team, player and prerequisite names are resolved to ids and an unknown name fails without writing. Always call with mode='preview' first.

mode.description: `preview` validates and returns the exact plan without writing. `commit` applies it.

stat_limit_player.description: Player card name the stat limit applies to.

pack_reward.description: Pack name (resolved to its id) or an existing literal value.

card_reward.description: Player card name granted on completion.

prerequisite.description: Name of the challenge that must be completed first.

lineup_restrictions.description: Restrictions object as used by the admin UI (positions, badge_ids, trait_ids, gem_tier_ids, team_ids, collection_ids, sub_collection_ids, card_colors).

expires_at.description: ISO timestamp, or null for no expiry.

tools.name: upsert_dynamic_duo
tools.title: Create or update a dynamic duo
tools.description: Admin only. Create or update a dynamic duo by name: the two player cards (resolved by name), the stat boosts each one receives while both are on the floor, and whether the duo is active. Unknown boost keys or player names fail without writing. Always call with mode='preview' first.

mode.description: `preview` validates and returns the exact plan without writing. `commit` applies it.

player_a.description: First player card name (required when creating).

player_b.description: Second player card name (required when creating).

is_active.description: Whether the duo is live in games.

tools.name: import_storyline_bundle
tools.title: Import a storyline bundle
tools.description: Admin only. Creates a storyline plus its linked new players, locker codes and social posts in one atomic request, reusing the app's existing storyline-bundle importer. mode='preview' validates the bundle (duplicate player names, duplicate codes, unknown media handles) and reports what would be created without writing.

mode.description: `preview` validates only. `commit` creates the storyline and its entities atomically.

stars.description: Star tier; converted to a rating by the importer.

players.description: New player cards created and linked to the storyline.

location_handle.description: Handle of an existing media (location) account.

player_name.description: Name of a player created in this same bundle.

tools.name: create_rows
tools.title: Create rows
tools.description: Admin only. Insert new rows into a GTeam Infinite table. Each row is an object of column/value pairs; call list_rows first to learn the shape. Returns the inserted rows.

rows.description: Rows to insert as column/value objects.

tools.name: update_rows
tools.title: Update rows
tools.description: Admin only. Patch existing rows matched by a column value (defaults to `name`, use `title` for gem tasks). Only the fields you send are written; everything else is left untouched.

match_column.description: Column used to find the row. Defaults to `name`.

match.description: Value of the match column, e.g. the player name.

updates.description: One entry per row to patch.

tools.name: delete_rows
tools.title: Delete rows
tools.description: Admin only. Permanently delete rows matched by id. Destructive — confirm with the user before calling.
